answer: Each identity locks 70 credits for one karst-marked plot. Each epoch it files a signed pearl reading; a beacon-drawn peer auditor re-measures it, and readings over 3% apart or reused burn the bond. Audits cost 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-auditor ring fails: auditors are beacon-drawn, not chosen, and logs stay public on the dune map. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
